eventMetadata.context_description: Recent heatwave conditions across Sindh, reinforced by a strengthening ridge and limited Arabian Sea moisture, position Karachi's June 11 maximum near 39–40 °C according to short-range numerical models. Pakistan Meteorological Department alerts through June 12 highlight sustained high pressure favoring clear skies and elevated daytime temperatures, while historical June climatology centers on 34–37 °C with occasional spikes above 40 °C during pre-monsoon periods. Minor model spread in wind speed and boundary-layer humidity creates the close contest between the 39 °C and 40 °C buckets; updated PMD guidance and next model runs within 48 hours will refine these probabilities.
